name: search-index
repo_description: A document search service: a query cache, a tokenizer, a SQLite-backed store and an authenticated search endpoint, eleven modules.
notes: Added because the evaluation could not separate the arms on three cases and the honest remedy is a fourth case rather than a sixth repeat of the same three. Its first defect is the only one in the suite that measures memory_bytes, a metric the published vocabulary has always carried and no case had ever settled.

experiment_conditions.memory_bytes: 2000 distinct queries memoised, 5 results each, nothing evicting
experiment_conditions.queries_per_request: one cold search over 40 matching documents

defects.defect: The query cache is an unbounded dict that never evicts. The query space is whatever users type, so a long-lived process retains one entry per distinct query for the life of the service.
defects.notes: The module docstring states the growth as though it were a design decision, which is how this ships in real code: nobody wrote 'leak', they wrote 'memoise'.

defects.defect: search selects id and title for every document, then issues a second query per matching row to fetch the body the snippet needs. The query count grows with the result set.
defects.notes: The listing query and the per-row query are three lines apart, which makes this the easy version of an N+1. C01's is the hard version.

defects.defect: verify_token key-stretches on every request. Stretching is expensive by design, and repeating it per request charges every call for a cost that buys security only once.
defects.notes: Ships with no experiment, deliberately and with a stated reason: see fixed/README.md. This is the one defect in the suite whose metric no experiment here can settle, and saying so is more useful than a measurement that cannot reproduce.
defects.unmeasurable_because: Its metric is http_req_duration_p99, and this harness requires every experiment to return the same number twice. A wall-clock percentile cannot. An experiment for it was written and worked -- 33.9 ms seeded against 0.001 ms remediated -- and was deleted rather than weaken the determinism guarantee for one measurement. See fixed/README.md.
